fcpr:9849b4eb5de6928bae4627aa09f42531334.rationale: The conclusion depends entirely on the auxiliary `IsCoprimeNonrepresentable` predicate rather than directly expressing the informal coprimeness and non-representability conditions, leaving the informal notions incorrectly encoded by that definition.

fcpr:064daf7ed8fa6f206fb84647f3a6dc91649.rationale: Every hypothesis in the formal statement (ε>0, p.natDegree = n, connectedness of {z : ℂ | ‖p.eval z‖ ≤ 1}, and z's membership in that sublevel set) corresponds directly to a condition in the informal statement, and the ∀ε>0/∀ᶠ n encoding of the (1/2+o(1))n² bound is the standard faithful one, so no extraneous hypothesis can be substantiated.

fcpr:9742b2b9e523562258bb6783606c33dad69.rationale: The informal text demands a genuine minimax game-value definition unfolding the finite game tree, but `formal_before` is only a signature with body `sorry`, an uninterpreted placeholder containing no connective to mislabel (so the wrong-connective hint cannot be substantiated).

fcpr:fbe4917de96511a6553e58144d59814110c.rationale: The formal statement filters elements of A k itself (normalized by √(N k)) instead of the sumset A k + A k (normalized by |A k + A k|) that the informal question asks about, thus stating the Lindström-type result for A rather than the sumset equidistribution claim.

fcpr:9742b2b9e523562258bb6783606c33dad69.rationale: The informal statement says a position consists merely of the claimed set and the unclaimed pool, but the structure bundles in primitivity, disjointness, range, and especially pool_compatible invariants, so only positions where every unclaimed number remains a legal move are representable—terminal positions with unplayable unclaimed leftovers cannot exist in the type, collapsing the game-over condition trivially to pool = ∅.

fcpr:78981183d1c7973f950bd3807381b40a8b0.rationale: The informal anti-homogeneous hypothesis (all conjugacy classes have distinct sizes) is replaced by [Subsingleton G], which collapses the theorem to the trivial one-element group whose center is automatically ⊥.

fcpr:714aaf5beb083dd071ce09ac8f8e15e4c37.rationale: The conjunction ¬ n.Prime ∧ 1 < n is exactly the definition of a composite natural number (0 and 1 are not prime, so the 1 < n condition is required, not extraneous), and (f n)^2 > n is equivalent to f(n) > n^{1/2} over ℕ, so the hint of an extraneous hypothesis cannot be substantiated.

fcpr:9742b2b9e523562258bb6783606c33dad69.rationale: The definition delegates the value to `gameLength (startPos n)` for all `n : ℕ`, so degenerate cases of `{2,…,n}` are resolved by Lean's default/junk behavior rather than by the intended primitive-set game.

fcpr:9cddd0ab157fb101a83eb179a1eaa5ea0cb.rationale: In Lean `2 • A` on a finset elaborates as the elementwise scaling `A.image (2 • ·)`, which in `ZMod 2` collapses to `{0}` rather than the sumset `A + A`, so only 0-dimensional cosets can lie in `2 • A` and the statement trivially forces the answer function to vanish at every attained density instead of expressing the open problem.
